title: Minecraft Horse Death
blurb: A short, unhappy whinny, cut off mid-breath. Mob death sounds in Minecraft are usually comic, the pig's squeal and the villager's grunt included, but the horse lands differently, because horses are one of the very few mobs players genuinely look after. You tame it, feed it, name it with a name tag, and then something goes wrong near a ravine. The clip has become community shorthand for a loss that is entirely your own fault. Handle it carefully in edits; it works far better as a punchline than as a jumpscare.
origin: The horse death sound from Minecraft.
